items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: And then I worked with him, too.

ctx.x: And then I worked with him, too. Edmund Hall? No, Thomas Mack. I worked with him a while. I do, too. He's working at the West New York office now. I telegraphed all these words, Porta de la. Oh, yeah. It's funny, I never met him. I worked with Mack and Thomas. Know who he looked like, Dick? Him and Thomas compared to brothers. Him and Kid Thomas? No, yeah, Kid Thomas compared to brothers. Mack and Thomas. Same height and everything, color and everything. Compared to brothers.
You ever been to Morris Park?
